ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   D. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.
   C. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   B. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   C. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Saum has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.

13. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

14. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.
   D. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.

15. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Relations with people of other faiths and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Corruption 04 7 History of Islam 7.1 Battle of Badr and Uhud 04 7.2 Treaty of Hu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain The Treaty of Hudaibiya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
